items.title: Fiserv Stock Rises on Report Big U.S. Banks Explore Buying Its Debit Card Network
items.summary: Shares of financial-tech firm  Fiserv  rose on Tuesday following reports that some of the largest U.S. banks have held discussions to acquire its debt-card payment processing network.  The company’s stock advanced 2.2% to $52.92 after The Wall Street Journal and Reuters reported that banks including  JPMorgan Chase Bank of America PNC Financial Services Group  and  Wells Fargo  have explored such a deal in recent months.  There is no certainty a deal will happen, and the nature of the banks’ discussions have been “preliminary and tentative,” the Journal reported.
